content_review: Keith Conrad's expository note develops the Galois correspondence through five worked examples, including explicit S_3 and D_4 Galois groups, subgroup/subfield diagrams, and fixed-field calculations. It is not organized as a standalone problem collection; the only exercise-like instruction is an inline check inside the worked exposition.
resource_route: wiki/algebra/resources/fields.md already links this retained PDF as an algebra reference, so no duplicate resource entry is needed.
